items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: I did another four years with Dizzy without a piano.

ctx.x: I was fascinated by, you’re talking about accompaniment, because one of my questions I had here was if you accompany somewhat differently playing behind an instrumentalist, Dizzy Gillespie or Sonny Stitt, as you do a vocalist? You started, I think you may have answered it but what would be the difference?

Well when you’re playing with guys like Dizzy they’re constantly changing directions. It’s just — when you’re working with singers you know they don’t change directions too much. They’re pretty much melody singers or they’ll scat a chorus or something like that but they don’t really divert from, they don’t divert from the tune too much. But guys like Dizzy, you know, every note has got the possibility of going somewhere else so it’s — what happens when you play with guys like that you have to play less and less…
Did you replace Mike Longo in his group?
